title: Mine, Somebody Else's, And Which Kind
label: ch:propio-y-ajeno
canDo: I can say propio, ajeno, igual, distinto and el tipo, and say why English proper meant owned long before it meant correct.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C350-tipo: mark a thing as yours or another's, as the same or a different one, and ask what sort it is.
